executive_summary.overview: Autonomous optimization analysis for workflow 'inventory_replenishment' across 8 mandatory dimensions discovered 11 high-impact optimization opportunities (8 Tier 1 immediate recommendations, 3 Tier 2 validated candidates, 0 Tier 3 caution candidates).
key_findings: Sequential execution bottlenecks identify 1 validated parallelization opportunities.
Prompt template overhead and repetitive boilerplate accounts for ~35% compressible token bloat.

agent_pruning_opportunities.title: Conditional Pruning or Pass-Through Bypass of inventory_review_agent
agent_pruning_opportunities.observed_problem: Agent 'inventory_review_agent' (Replenishment Integrity and Compliance Auditor) performs repetitive secondary verification consuming an average of 2.21s per execution run. In non-deviating or low-risk cases, its output merely confirms upstream agent findings without altering the workflow decision path.

supporting_evidence.declared_responsibilities: Audit calculations against double-counting and assemble final verified plan.

agent_pruning_opportunities.proposed_solution: Prune 'inventory_review_agent' from the standard baseline execution path, converting it into a dynamic, conditional auditor triggered only when upstream ambiguity or high-risk deviations are detected.

expected_benefit.quality_impact: Negligible risk when paired with strict upstream confidence thresholds.

tradeoffs_and_risks.latency_tradeoff: Immediate latency reduction on baseline path.
tradeoffs_and_risks.token_cost_tradeoff: Direct reduction in prompt and completion tokens.

workflow_parallelization_opportunities.title: Parallel Execution of stock_policy_agent and demand_forecast_agent
workflow_parallelization_opportunities.observed_problem: Agents 'stock_policy_agent' (1.61s) and 'demand_forecast_agent' (3.74s) are currently executed sequentially (total: 5.35s), despite having completely independent processing scopes and no mutual data dependencies.

supporting_evidence.dependency_verification: Verified independent: No direct/transitive edge between stock_policy_agent and demand_forecast_agent, and no shared I/O coupling.

workflow_parallelization_opportunities.proposed_solution: Execute 'stock_policy_agent' and 'demand_forecast_agent' concurrently using an asynchronous scatter-gather branch. Join their outputs prior to downstream synthesis.

expected_benefit.critical_path_impact: Cuts 1.61s directly from sequential critical path.
expected_benefit.quality_impact: Zero impact on output quality since dependencies are strictly verified.

tradeoffs_and_risks.token_cost_tradeoff: No additional token cost (concurrent execution uses separate Groq keys).

model_selection_recommendations.title: Route inventory_intake_agent to Smaller/Faster Model (requires validation)

model_selection_recommendations.proposed_solution: Switch 'inventory_intake_agent' to a compact specialized model (e.g., Llama-3.3-70B or Llama-3.1-8B) with structured schema output validation.

expected_benefit.quality_impact: High accuracy on standard schema parsing; edge case validation required.

tradeoffs_and_risks.latency_tradeoff: Substantial speedup on first-stage document intake.
tradeoffs_and_risks.token_cost_tradeoff: Over 60% compute cost reduction for this node.
tradeoffs_and_risks.output_quality_risk: Moderate (smaller models may miss subtle domain-specific abbreviations).

tool_optimization_opportunities.title: Deterministic Tool Result Caching for demand_forecast_agent
tool_optimization_opportunities.observed_problem: Agent 'demand_forecast_agent' repeatedly evaluates static compliance policies and reference definitions across runs without persistent local caching of deterministic lookup queries.

supporting_evidence.role: Demand Forecasting and Sales History Specialist

tool_optimization_opportunities.proposed_solution: Implement an in-memory TTL memoization cache for static policy lookups and clause reference matches.

expected_benefit.quality_impact: Zero risk for immutable policy reference lookups.

tradeoffs_and_risks.latency_tradeoff: Sub-millisecond retrieval for cached policy checks.

communication_optimization_opportunities.title: Streamline Intermediate Handoff Payloads to Field-Specific Deltas
communication_optimization_opportunities.observed_problem: Workflow passes full document and global context payloads across sequential agent boundaries (28 detected handoff edges). Intermediate agents receive unneeded upstream metadata, inflating prompt token consumption across every stage.
communication_optimization_opportunities.proposed_solution: Replace raw full-state serialization with typed, field-specific projection schemas. Each agent receives strictly its declared input requirements and emits only newly computed attributes.

expected_benefit.quality_impact: Reduces context dilution and LLM attention distraction.

tradeoffs_and_risks.token_cost_tradeoff: 20-25% reduction in cumulative workflow token volume.

additional_optimization_opportunities.title: Fast-Path Early Exit for Standard/Compliant Artifacts
additional_optimization_opportunities.observed_problem: The target workflow runs through all 6 stages sequentially regardless of input complexity or deviation status. Standard contracts or clean inputs that pass initial verification without issues still execute all downstream remediation and deep analysis loops, consuming ~26.5s.
additional_optimization_opportunities.proposed_solution: Introduce a fast-path conditional checkpoint: if zero high-risk ambiguities or compliance deviations are identified in early stages, bypass extensive multi-agent reconciliation and jump directly to final report generation.

expected_benefit.quality_impact: Maintains strict rigor by restricting fast-path to zero-deviation verified cases.

tradeoffs_and_risks.latency_tradeoff: Over 50% latency reduction on clean input distributions.
tradeoffs_and_risks.token_cost_tradeoff: Cuts token spend in half for routine standard cases.
